description: Agents forces one call to tool2 with the arguments the prompt gives. The gateway sends tool2, not tool1, because EnableByoGeminiForAgents is on in every environment; it accepts one or two calls because EnableParallelToolCallsExemption is on.

parts.text:
Please process the following:
1. A string input: "This is a test."
2. A numeric input: 42

function_declarations.name: tool2
function_declarations.description: Processes a generic user input, either string or numeric. Use option1 for string input and option2 for numeric input.

ifBodyContains: are not supported for this model
retries.why: the model refuses a forced tool choice; the gateway sends it once more with tool choice auto

checks.says: candidates is an array of objects whose content.parts is an array

checks.jq: ((.candidates // []) | length) as $n | ($n == 1 and (.candidates[0].index // 0) == 0) or ($n == 0 and .promptFeedback.blockReason != null)

checks.says: the answer comes from the assistant
every call is tool2; one call carries one of the two expected argument sets, two calls carry both
checks.jq: [.candidates[0].content.parts[]? | (.functionCall // .function_call) | select(. != null) | {name, args}] as $calls | [{"parameter1": "option1", "parameter2": "This is a test."}, {"parameter1": "option2", "parameter2": "42"}] as $expected | ($calls | length) as $n | $n > 0 and all($calls[]; .name == "tool2" and .args != null) and (if $n == 1 then any($expected[]; . == $calls[0].args) elif $n == 2 then ($calls | map(.args) | sort) == ($expected | sort) else false end)
